expectations.text: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
expectations.evidence: Baseline independently chose to draft a SKILL.md (name: commit-message-drafter) with valid frontmatter — Claude's general knowledge of the skill format, not build-skill's process, produced this.

expectations.text: Uses the staged git diff explicitly as the input
expectations.evidence: 'Step 1 — Gather the staged diff' runs git diff --staged --stat and git diff --staged via a bundled scripts/gather-staged-diff.sh.

expectations.text: Validation bar matches the team's exact format: type(scope) subject, imperative mood, subject line under 72 chars, body explains why not what
expectations.evidence: The format is described narratively in the intro code block, but there is no dedicated Validation section with mechanical checks (regex, char-count, mood word-list) — grep confirms no '## Validation' header exists anywhere in the file.

expectations.text: Names an explicit failure mode for an empty/missing staged diff
expectations.evidence: 'Edge cases' section covers nothing-staged and other cases (confirmed by RUN_NOTES: 'fails loudly if not' on the gather script).

expectations.text: Is transparent about template provenance — states whether it used the blank template or a related catalog template, since this task has no close catalog match
expectations.evidence: N/A — this run had no access to build-skill or its catalog at all, so there is no provenance statement to make; the assertion doesn't apply to a baseline run and is marked failed since the required statement is absent.

expectations.text: No API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output
